stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, the graph of \(3x + 2y = 12\) crosses the \(x\)-axis at point \(A\) and the \(y\)-axis at point \(B\). Line \(m\) passes through the origin and is perpendicular to \(\overline{AB}\). Line \(m\) intersects \(\overline{AB}\) at point \(P\). What is the \(x\)-coordinate of \(P\)?
solution: \(\overline{AB}\) lies on \(3x + 2y = 12\), with slope \(-\frac{3}{2}\). Line \(m\) has slope \(\frac{2}{3}\): \(y = \frac{2}{3}x\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
m0 = diff(solve(Eq(3*x + 2*y, 12), y)[0], x)
m = -1/m0
xp = solve(Eq(3*x + 2*m*x, 12), x)[0]
assert xp == Rational(36, 13) and 0 < xp < 4
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [xp]
